data.one_liner: Lean Builder: a fast, efficient Dart build system for code generation
data.what_it_does: Lean Builder provides a streamlined alternative to the Dart build system, enabling fast incremental builds and hot reload for generators. It offers declarative builder configuration via annotations and supports shared part, library, and standard builders.
use_when: You need to create code generators with fast incremental builds
You want a simpler, more performant alternative to build_runner
You need watch mode with hot reload for generator development
avoid_when: You require the full feature set of the official Dart build system
Your project is already heavily dependent on build_runner and source_gen
strengths: Hot reload support in watch mode
weaknesses: May lack some advanced features of the official build system
data.setup_notes: Add lean_builder as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml. Run commands like `dart run lean_builder build` or `dart run lean_builder watch`. No additional build_runner setup required.

alternatives.name: build_runner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard, widely adopted build system with extensive ecosystem

alternatives.name: source_gen
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular code generation library that works with build_runner
